subject: Request: one-time promo credit carveout & staged discount for BrightSeed cohort
messages:
From: Beth Carter <beth@brightseed.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightseed.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo stacking for Fall Cohort (BrightSeed)

Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — we liked the latency profile and the token pricing looks reasonable for our mentoring assistants. Quick ask from the programs team: our accelerator provides startups with a $10k cloud credit that many of the cohort teams want to apply to Redwood consumption. Can Redwood allow those program credits to stack with a short-term promotional discount for the first 3 months?

Specifically: 
- Allow cohort credits to be applied to the account (we can provide procurement contact for invoicing).
- One-time promotional discount for cohort companies staged over their first three billing cycles (30% month 1, 20% month 2, 10% month 3).

We understand exceptions are policy work — happy to share cohort list and SOW draft (attached). Our pilot cohort launches Oct 6, so we’re on a tight timetable.

Appreciate any flexibility — Beth

--
Beth Carter
Head of Accelerator Programs, BrightSeed Labs
beth@brightseed.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Beth Carter <beth@brightseed.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo stacking for Fall Cohort (BrightSeed)

Beth — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. I copied Marissa (Sales Ops) and Ben (Pricing) so we can evaluate the carveout. High-level thoughts:

- Stacking cohort credits with a short promotional discount is possible but will require a one-time pricing exception and a defined cap per account to avoid abuse.
- We usually surface a signed SOW + procurement PO before applying credits; procurement@brightseed.ai on the thread is perfect.
- Need to confirm whether BrightSeed credits are customer-managed credits (applied by the customer) or if BrightSeed wants Redwood to honor an invoice-credit flow.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa to confirm the exception form and cap (suggest $5k max promo discount per startup) and route to Ben for sign-off.
2) If approved, we’ll generate a templated addendum for each cohort company to sign; I’ll include a conditional clause tying the staged discount to token consumption thresholds.

Marissa/Ben — can you advise if $5k promo cap and the staged 30/20/10 cadence are workable from finance & compliance? If too aggressive, suggest alt.

I’ll hold off formal confirmation to BrightSeed until we have ops/finance sign-off.

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Promo stacking for Fall Cohort (BrightSeed)

Marcus / Ben — quick internal note after reviewing the attachments. Key compliance/ops items: 

- We can process cohort credits as "partner credits" (BrightSeed supplies an invoice list; Redwood issues consumption billing net of credits). That preserves accounting controls.
- Pricing exception: legal prefers a one-time exception form signed by Sales Lead + Revenue Ops. Finance flagged that a $5k promo cap per startup is acceptable if we require the cap be applied as a credit ledger entry (not refunded cash).
- The staged discount cadence (30/20/10) is unusual but can be modeled as a percentage credit applied to billed consumption for first three invoices if each invoice meets a minimum $1k consumption threshold.

Actionables:
- Ben: can you approve the exception and confirm the credit ledger flow? If yes I’ll prepare the pricing_exception_form.xlsx and mark checkbox for revenue ops approval.
- Marcus: please collect the procurement PO from procurement@brightseed.ai and confirm cohort roster. We’ll need each company’s billing account ID.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Beth Carter <beth@brightseed.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Promo stacking for Fall Cohort (BrightSeed)

All — Ben here from Pricing/Revenue Ops. Approve the one-time exception with the following guardrails: 

1) Cap the promotional discount at $4,500 per startup (revised down from $5k) applied as a non-cash credit on the customer ledger.
2) Staged discount will be applied to the first three billed cycles in the 30/20/10 split but only if each invoice meets the $1k consumption minimum. If a cohort company invoices below $1k in any month, the staged discount for that month will not apply (no retroactive adjustments).
3) BrightSeed must provide a signed cohort roster + procurement PO prior to Redwood issuing credits. We’ll add the clause to the addendum.
4) Legal will require the standard pricing_exception_form.xlsx to be returned signed by BrightSeed and Redwood sales lead.

Beth — if this is acceptable we’ll issue templated addenda and a DocuSign envelope for the cohort. I’ve attached the exception form and a short SOW checklist.

If BrightSeed wants a higher cap we can consider a revenue share offset, but that needs a commercial review and longer lead time.

Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Pricing & RevOps, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

--
Attachments: pricing_exception_form.xlsx, BrightSeed_SOW_Draft.pdf
